ui.intro: Avatar Texture Optimizer analyses your avatar's meshes, shrinks the parts of every texture that are actually used, and repacks them into shared atlases. It only ever changes mesh UVs and texture references - no other material parameter is touched.
ui.tier.Lossless: Near lossless. Textures are copied unchanged; only atlasing and import settings are applied.
ui.tier.VeryHigh: Very high. Differences should be invisible even under close inspection.
ui.tier.High: High. Differences are at the classic just-noticeable threshold.
ui.tier.Performance: Performance. Visible on close inspection, much smaller.
ui.tier.Mobile: Mobile. Aimed at Quest and other constrained platforms.
ui.tier.Custom: Custom. You control every threshold; other tiers never overwrite it.
ui.whitelist.help: Drop any object here - a GameObject, renderer, mesh, material, texture, animation clip or animator. Every texture reachable from it is left completely untouched.
ui.allowNpot: Allow non power of two atlases (experimental)
ui.allowNpot.help: Atlas edges step in 64 texel increments instead of powers of two. This packs tighter, but compression formats that require power of two sizes are excluded automatically.
ui.textureSettings.help: Defaults are the best general choice for the current build platform. Change these only if you know what you need.
ui.q.readonly: These values come from the selected tier. Choose the Custom tier to edit them.
ATO:warn:uvCrossesSeam: UVs leave the 0-1 range and cross a wrap seam
ATO:warn:uvCrossesSeam:description: Mesh '{0}' sub mesh {1} channel UV{2} relies on texture wrapping, which cannot be reproduced in an atlas. Its textures were left unoptimized.
ATO:warn:uvCrossesSeam:hint: Move the UV island back into the 0-1 range, or add the mesh to the whitelist to silence this warning.
ATO:warn:groupTooLarge: A texture group does not fit into any allowed atlas
ATO:warn:groupTooLarge:description: UV group {0} with {1} islands is larger than the largest atlas allowed on this platform. Its textures were scaled but not atlased.
ATO:warn:groupTooLarge:hint: Lower the quality tier or the maximum texel density so the islands become smaller.
ATO:warn:noFreeUvChannel: No free UV channel to preserve the original UVs
ATO:warn:noFreeUvChannel:description: Renderer '{0}' uses UV{1} in a way Avatar Optimizer reads, but all eight UV channels are already in use, so the original coordinates could not be saved.
ATO:warn:noFreeUvChannel:hint: Remove an unused UV channel from the mesh, or add the renderer to the whitelist.
ATO:warn:aaoEvacuationFailed: Avatar Optimizer refused the UV evacuation
ATO:warn:aaoEvacuationFailed:description: Renderer '{0}': Avatar Optimizer rejected the channel ATO offered. The original UVs were not preserved.
ATO:warn:aaoEvacuationFailed:hint: Add the renderer to the whitelist if its Avatar Optimizer features misbehave.
ATO:warn:cancelled:description: Optimization stopped at the user's request. Temporary assets were left on disk and all GPU memory was released.
ATO:warn:cancelled:hint: Run the build again to finish optimizing.
ATO:error:multipleComponents: More than one Avatar Texture Optimizer component
ATO:error:multipleComponents:description: {0} components were found on this avatar, but only one is allowed.
ATO:error:multipleComponents:hint: Delete the extra components and build again.
ATO:error:notOnDescriptor: The component is not on the avatar descriptor
ATO:error:notOnDescriptor:description: Avatar Texture Optimizer must sit on the same object as the VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ATO:error:notOnDescriptor:hint: Move the component onto the avatar root.
ATO:error:notOnRoot: The component is not on the avatar root
ATO:error:notOnRoot:description: Avatar Texture Optimizer must sit on the avatar root object.
ATO:error:notOnRoot:hint: Move the component onto the avatar root.
ATO:error:internal:hint: Enable verbose logging and report the [ATO] console output as an issue.
